scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently --names api,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run format:check -w server && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run format:check -w frontend
scripts.fmt: npm run format -w server && npm run format -w frontend
